name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
description: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), the St. Louis Fed's database of US and international economic time series: headline US indicators such as the monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE), CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL), GDP (GDP, GDPC1), nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and Treasury yields (DGS10), plus 800,000+ other series. Search series by text, browse categories, releases, sources and tags, read one series' metadata (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, source, notes, date range, last update) and fetch its observations (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual values) with date window, frequency aggregation and transformation, paginated, from the site's keyless JSON, CSV and HTML endpoints.

tools.name: Category
tools.description: Discover series by topic instead of by text: start at the root, follow `children[].category_id`, then read `series[].series_id` for `series` / `series_observations`.

options.name: category_id
options.about: FRED category id (integer, e.g. 106 for GDP/GNP, 32991 for Money, Banking, & Finance; 0 or omitted for the root), a numeric string, or a pasted https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/{id} URL.

options.name: page
options.about: Series page within the category (50 series per page); pass `next_page` from the previous result.

response.about: Browse the FRED category tree from the site's category pages (server-rendered HTML). Without `category_id` (or with 0) it lists the top-level categories; with an id it returns that category's name, breadcrumb path, child categories (with FRED's printed series count) and the series listed on one page (50 per page, `pageID` pagination via `page`/`next_page`), each with id, title, the attributes line as printed (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment) and the observation range as printed. An unknown category id is `not_found`.

tools.description: Confirm what a `series_id` (or a pasted fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} page URL) measures and which `units`/`frequency` values `series_observations` accepts for it; the data points themselves come from `series_observations`.

options.name: series_id
options.about: FRED series id, e.g. GDP, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL (case-insensitive), or a pasted https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} URL.

response.about: Metadata for one FRED economic time series (e.g. UNRATE unemployment rate, CPIAUCSL consumer price index, GDP) from the site's series JSON (graph/api/series): title, units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, source, notes, first and last observation date, last update, the transformations (units codes) and aggregation frequencies FRED offers for it. An unknown series id is `not_found`.

fields.name: available_frequencies
fields.about: Aggregation frequencies FRED offers for this series (native first), e.g. Quarterly, Semiannual, Annual.

fields.name: last_updated

fields.name: notes
fields.about: FRED notes (source account codes, methodology, copyright or citation notes). Null when the site carries none.

fields.name: source
fields.about: Data source as printed under the chart, e.g. U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. Null when the site prints none.

fields.name: units
fields.about: Units of the level series (transformation `lin`), e.g. Billions of Dollars.

tools.name: Series observations
tools.description: Get the historical values of a known `series_id` or a pasted fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} page URL (monthly US unemployment rate = UNRATE, CPI = CPIAUCSL, real GDP = GDPC1); pick `units` and `frequency` from `series.available_units` / `series.available_frequencies`. Use `series_search` first when only the concept is known.

options.name: aggregation_method
options.about: How observations are aggregated when `frequency` is lower than native: average, sum or end of period.

options.name: frequency
options.about: Aggregate to a lower frequency (FRED API codes: d daily, w weekly, bw biweekly, m monthly, q quarterly, sa semiannual, a annual). Omit for the native frequency.

options.name: limit
options.about: Observations per page.

options.name: observation_end
options.about: Last observation date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: observation_start
options.about: First observation date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: offset
options.about: Zero-based index of the first observation to return, in `sort_order`; pass `next_offset` from the previous page.

options.name: series_id
options.about: FRED series id, e.g. GDP, UNRATE (case-insensitive), or a pasted https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} page URL or https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=... URL (its `id` is used; other query parameters are ignored).

options.name: sort_order
options.about: Date order of the observations.

options.name: units
options.about: FRED transformation code: lin levels, chg change, ch1 change from year ago, pch percent change, pc1 percent change from year ago, pca compounded annual rate of change, cch continuously compounded rate of change, cca continuously compounded annual rate of change, log natural log.

response.about: The data points of one FRED economic time series, e.g. the monthly US unemployment rate (UNRATE), CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL), quarterly GDP, nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) or the 10-year Treasury yield (DGS10), from the site's keyless CSV export (graph/fredgraph.csv): date/value rows, optionally windowed by date, aggregated to a lower frequency and transformed (percent change, change from year ago, ...). The full CSV is fetched once and paginated client-side with `limit`/`offset`; `count` is the total number of rows FRED returned for the request. Values FRED leaves blank (not yet published, missing) are `value: null` with `raw: "."`, matching the FRED API's missing-value marker. Vintage (as-of) data is not available on this endpoint. An unknown series id is `not_found`.

fields.name: raw
fields.about: The value as FRED prints it; "." marks a missing value, as in the FRED API.

fields.name: value
fields.about: Numeric value; null when FRED reports the observation as missing.

response.about: Search FRED series by free text through the site's series autocomplete (graph/api/series/sitesearch). tools.name: Tags
tools.description: Discover tag names to combine in `tag_series`.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page (50 rows per page); pass `next_page` from the previous result.

response.about: List FRED tags (keywords attached to series: geography, frequency, seasonal adjustment, source, concept) from the site's /tags page, ordered by series count, 50 per page with `page`/`next_page`; `total` is the count FRED prints ("Tags 1 - 50 of 6079"). Each tag carries its machine name (`tag`, the value for `tag_series.tag_names`), display name and the series count as printed. The site serves the first 30 pages (1,500 most-used tags) and answers 404 beyond them: `next_page` is null on page 30 and a page past the end is `not_found`.

fields.name: name
fields.about: Display name, e.g. Not Seasonally Adjusted.

fields.name: series_count
fields.about: Series count as FRED prints it, e.g. "680,000+"; null when not printed.

fields.name: tag
fields.about: Tag name as FRED's API and URLs use it, e.g. nsa, usa, gdp, quarterly.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Series-by-tag page on fred.stlouisfed.org.
